# Validation Domain Statistical Method / Metric Empirical Value Threshold Status Scientific Finding
Spring 2022 Mega-Heatwave
Northwest India Historic Crisis

During March–May 2022, temperatures consistently exceeded 46°C in Rajasthan and MP. The model triggered a 96.5% anomaly alert rate in Bikaner with composite SSI spiking from 0.596 to 0.751 (t = 3.46, p = 0.0008).

Delhi Winter Inversion Smog
Boundary-Layer Subsidence

Severe post-monsoon stagnation traps agricultural and vehicular emissions (PM2.5 mean 355.3 µg/m³). SSI captures this as a continuous +16.2% seasonal stress lift, accurately diagnosing vulnerability in cold periods.

October 2021 Hyderabad Deluge
Deccan Plateau Cloudburst

Deep depressions triggered severe urban flooding and lake breaches. Mean SSI spiked to 0.682, triggering a 100.0% city-wide anomaly alert (all 1,505 cells flagged), aligning exactly with municipal emergency declarations.

Mathematical Formulation of Smooth SSI
Eliminating boundary clipping artifacts via asymptotic damping.
SSI_lin = ∑ (w_j · S_j) where w_j = 0.2000

Ω_compound = I(S_heat ≥ q_90) × I(S_poll ≥ q_90)

SSI = SSI_lin + γ · Ω_compound · (1.0 - SSI_lin)
[where γ = 0.30, q = 0.90]

The term (1.0 - SSI_lin) acts as an endogenous damping factor: as linear stress approaches 1.0, incremental amplification decelerates gracefully. This guarantees that scores remain strictly bounded in [0, 1] without hard clamping (0.00% ceiling truncation).
